content:
url: https://biodatacatalyst.nhlbi.nih.gov/help/get-help/
fields:
  - name: cf_requestors_name
    label: Full Name
    type: custom_text
    required: true
  - name: requester
    label: Email
    type: default_requester
    required: true
  - name: cf_subject
    label: Subject
    type: custom_text
    required: true
  - name: ticket_type
    label: Select the Type of Assistance Needed
    type: default_ticket_type
    required: true
    choices:
      - Select the Type of Assistance Needed
      - Exploring/Accessing BDC-hosted Data
      - Publishing Research
      - Bringing Your Own Data (BYOD)
      - Analyzing Data/Using a BDC Workspace
      - Sharing Data/Data Submission
      - Usage Costs/Cloud Credits
      - Interest in Collaborating with BDC
      - Privacy Policy/Terms of Use
      - Login Issue
      - Website Issue
      - Provide Feedback
      - Other
    sections:
      - choices:
          - Publishing Research
        fields:
          - name: cf_paper_title_or_working_title
            label: Paper Title (or Working Title)
            type: custom_paragraph
            required: true
          - name: cf_expected_date_of_publication_if_known
            label: Expected Date of Publication (if known) - If the manuscript has already been published, please indicate that date in the “Expected date of publication” field.
            type: custom_date
            required: false
          - name: cf_journal_name
            label: Journal Name - BDC will honor and enforce all embargoes (no leaks) and contact you before posting or publishing anything.
            type: custom_text
            required: false
          - name: cf_link_to_the_manuscript_if_available
            label: 'Link to the Manuscript (if available) - Remember to include BDC’s citation/acknowledgment in the manuscripts you submit to journals: https://bdcatalyst.gitbook.io/biodata-catalyst-documentation/community/citation-and-acknowledgement'
            type: custom_text
            required: false
  - name: cf_submitted_description
    label: Description
    type: custom_paragraph
    required: true
  - name: cf_research_community
    label: Select a Research Community
    type: custom_dropdown
    required: false
    choices:
      - Bench to Bassinet
      - BioLINCC
      - C4R
      - CONNECTS
      - Cure Sickle Cell Initiative
      - HeartShare
      - LungMAP
      - NSRR
      - Pediatric Heart Network
      - PETAL Network
      - RECOVER
      - RMIP
      - TOPMed
      - Other
  - name: cf_other_research_community
    label: 'If your research community is not listed, please describe here:'
    type: custom_text
    required: false

url: https://biodatacatalyst.nhlbi.nih.gov/help/contact-bdc/
fields:
  - name: full_name
    label: Full Name
    type: TEXT
    required: true
  - name: email
    label: Email
    type: TEXT
    required: true
  - name: subject
    label: Subject
    type: TEXT
    required: true
  - name: select_type_of_contact
    label: Select type of contact
    type: DROPDOWN
    required: true
    choices:
      - Data Submission
      - Find Data
      - Interest in Collaborating with BDC
      - Privacy Policy/Terms of Use
      - Website Issue
      - Provide Feedback
      - Other
  - name: message_to_bdc
    label: Description
    type: PARAGRAPH
    required: true

url: https://biodatacatalyst.nhlbi.nih.gov/help/costs/
fields:
  - name: cf_requestors_name
    label: Requestor's Name
    type: custom_text
    required: true
  - name: requester
    label: Requestor's Email
    type: default_requester
    required: true
  - name: cf_cloud_credits_project_pi
    label: Project PI
    type: custom_text
    required: false
  - name: cf_cf_cloud_credits_collaborator_information
    label: Requestor's Role
    type: custom_paragraph
    required: true
  - name: cf_cf_organization
    label: Requestor's Organization
    type: custom_text
    required: true
  - name: cf_research_community
    label: Select a Research Community
    type: custom_dropdown
    required: true
    choices:
      - Bench to Bassinet
      - BioLINCC
      - C4R
      - CONNECTS
      - Cure Sickle Cell Initiative
      - HeartShare
      - LungMAP
      - NSRR
      - Pediatric Heart Network
      - PETAL Network
      - RECOVER
      - RMIP
      - TOPMed
      - Other
  - name: cf_other_research_community
    label: 'If your research community is not listed, please describe here:'
    type: custom_text
    required: false
  - name: cf_cloud_credits_project_name
    label: Project Name
    type: custom_text
    required: true
  - name: cf_cloud_credits_collaborator_information
    label: Team Members
    type: custom_paragraph
    required: true
  - name: cf_cloud_credits_related_to_hlbs_description
    label: 'How is your research related to HLBS (heart, lung, blood, and sleep)? '
    type: custom_paragraph
    required: true
  - name: cf_cloud_credits_how_did_you_learn_about_bdc
    label: How did the requestor learn about BDC?
    type: custom_paragraph
    required: true
  - name: cf_cloud_credits_request_type
    label: 'BDC users may request one of the following:'
    type: custom_dropdown
    required: true
    choices:
      - NHLBI BDC Pilot Funding Program
      - NHLBI BDC Cloud Credit Support Program
      - Cloud Credits for Academic Classes and Group Educational Sessions
    sections:
      - choices:
          - NHLBI BDC Cloud Credit Support Program
        fields:
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_project_namedescription
            label: Project Name & Description
            type: custom_paragraph
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_previous_request196891
            label: Previous receipt of cloud credits from BDC (including Pilot Funding and other Cloud Credit Support Program approvals)
            type: custom_checkbox
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_computational_scope
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Computational Scope'
            type: custom_paragraph
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_estimated_need
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Estimated Need'
            type: custom_number
            required: false
          - name: cf_estimated_cloud_credits_requested
            label: Estimated cloud credits requested?
            type: custom_number
            required: false
          - name: cf_justification_for_credits
            label: What will you use these credits for?
            type: custom_paragraph
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_anticipated_timeline_for_the_work
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Anticipated timeline for the work'
            type: custom_text
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_certify_insufficient_funding
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Certify insufficient funding'
            type: custom_checkbox
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_research_results_link
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Research results link'
            type: custom_text
            required: false
      - choices:
          - Cloud Credits for Academic Classes and Group Educational Sessions
        fields:
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_course_title
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Course Title'
            type: custom_text
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_course_instructors_name
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Course Instructor''s Name'
            type: custom_text
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_anticipated_number_of_students
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Anticipated Number of Students'
            type: custom_number
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_course_level
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Course Level'
            type: custom_text
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_anticipated_coursepresentation_date
            label: 'Cloud Credits: Anticipated Course/Presentation Date'
            type: custom_date
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_support_during_course_from_bdc
            label: Do you wish to have support during the course/presentation from a BDC representative?
            type: custom_checkbox
            required: false
      - choices:
          - NHLBI BDC Pilot Funding Program
        fields:
          - name: cf_what_bdcatalyst_service_will_you_use
            label: Preferred analysis platform
            type: custom_dropdown
            required: false
            choices:
              - BDC-Seven Bridges
              - BDC-Terra
              - Both BDC-Seven Bridges and BDC-Terra
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_bdcseven_bridges_username
            label: BDC-Seven Bridges Username
            type: custom_text
            required: false
          - name: cf_cloud_credits_bdcterra_username
            label: BDC-Terra Username
            type: custom_text
            required: false
  - name: cf_by_submitting_this_form_i_agree_to_the_terms_and_conditions_of_this_offering
    label: By submitting this form, I agree to the requirements noted above, the BDC Terms of Use and Policies, and to receive emails from BDC. I can opt out of receiving emails at any time.
    type: custom_checkbox
    required: true
